title: JPS serah 2 pos kawalan kepada PGA perkukuh keselamatan sempadan Malaysia-Thailand
summary: PASIR MAS: Jabatan Pengairan dan Saliran (JPS) Kelantan hari ini menyerahkan dua pos kawalan yang baharu siap dibina kepada Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) bagi memperkukuh keselamatan dan pemantauan di sepanjang sempadan Malaysia-Thailand.

title_en: JPS hand over 2 control posts to PGA strengthen Malaysia-Thailand border security
summary_en: PASIR MAS: Kelantan Irrigation and Sewerage Authority (JPS) today handed over two newly built control posts to the General Mobile Forces (PGA) in order to strengthen security and surveillance along the Malaysia-Thailand border.

title: Four of 12 control posts under Golok River basin project handed over to GOF
summary: PASIR MAS: The Kelantan Department of Irrigation and Drainage (DID) has handed over four of the 12 General Operations Force (GOF) control posts constructed under Phase One of the Sungai Golok Integrated River Basin Development Project (PLSB), which began in 2018.
